finding: Software development postings on Indeed in the US rose roughly 15% over the year to mid-2026 while postings overall fell about 7%, yet they were still about 27.5% below their pre-pandemic level.
figure: +15% year on year, still 27.5% below Feb 2020
implication: Demand is recovering from a low base rather than booming, so expect a selective market and plan for a longer search than in 2021.

source.name: Indeed Hiring Lab, "AI and Job Postings: From Destruction to Creation?"

finding: Indeed found that most of the recent rise in software postings came from senior roles (71% of the increase) and from jobs that mention AI in the title (37% of the increase).
implication: The recovery rewards experience and AI fluency. Early-career candidates must close the gap with visible proof of work and AI-assisted engineering skill.

source.name: Indeed Hiring Lab, "AI and Job Postings: From Destruction to Creation?"

finding: Indeed's US software development postings index (February 2020 = 100) was reported at 78.3 on 2 October 2026, up from 64.3 a year earlier and from a low of 61.1 in May 2025.
implication: Five straight quarters of recovery suggest conditions are improving, but still about a fifth below the pre-pandemic baseline.

source.name: Rockstar Developer University, citing Indeed Hiring Lab data via FRED

finding: Only about 4.5% of US software development postings in the first quarter of 2026 were entry-level, the smallest share of any sector Indeed measured, while senior roles made up roughly 69%.
implication: Few postings are aimed at beginners, so a polished resume alone will not stand out. Build evidence (shipped projects, contest results, open-source work) before applying widely.

source.name: Rockstar Developer University, citing Indeed Hiring Lab

finding: Entry-level hiring at major tech employers was reported to be about 65% below its 2019 level, with AI taking on much of the small, well-defined work that once trained juniors.
implication: Do not count on being trained on trivial tickets. Learn to own larger pieces end to end and to verify AI-generated code.

finding: Handshake reported that postings aimed at the Class of 2026 fell below 2020 levels and that applications per job were up about 26% year on year by August 2025.
implication: Competition per opening is high, which makes referrals, internships and public proof of work worth more than volume applications.

finding: Layoffs.fyi had counted more than 126,000 tech layoffs by mid-August 2026, already above the roughly 122,600 it counted in all of 2025.
implication: More experienced engineers are on the market too, so juniors compete with them for some roles. Differentiate with specialisation rather than generic skills.

finding: Commentary on the 2026 market notes that firms still hiring juniors tend to favour people who already ship software, contribute to open source, or bring a specialisation.
implication: Treat shipped projects and open-source contributions as part of the curriculum, not an afterthought.
